title: If you're posting from the >x< for iOS or >x< for Android app, you can add up to 25 stickers to a photo. To add a sticker to an image:

runs: Tap the
icon ( on iOS or Android).
Tap the
icon to take a photo or to select one from your camera roll.
Tap the
icon from the selected photo to launch a library of stickers to choose from. Tap the sticker(s) you want and then drag with your finger to where you place it where you want it.
To tilt, enlarge, or shrink a sticker: Place two fingers on either side of the sticker and turn the sticker clockwise or counterclockwise to rotate, or slide your fingers apart or together to resize.
To remove a sticker from a photo, press and hold on the sticker, then drag it to the bottom of your screen until the
icon appears.
Once you have posted your photo with stickers, you can't edit the image. You also can't edit stickers when Reposting someone else’s photo.

Tagging location

When you select a photo or GIF, you might see Add location and a list of suggested locations under the image. To tag your photo or GIF with a location, tap Add location to select a location from a list, or tap one of the locations suggested based on your current location or the location where you took the photo. You can also search for a location by tapping the location marker icon or by tapping Search locations.
To remove the image file you selected, select the

on the image thumbnail (or next to the file name). To remove a tag, tap the tag and then the backspace or delete button. You can only do this before you post the photo. You can’t remove tags from a photo once it is posted.

q: How many characters do photos and GIFs use?

runs: None, photo and GIF attachments do not count towards the character limit in a Post (in iOS, Android, x.com, and mobile web clients-only).

q: What are the size and file type requirements?

runs: Photos can be up to 5MB; animated GIFs can be up to 5MB on mobile, and up to 15MB on web.
We accept GIF, JPEG, and PNG files.
We DO NOT accept BMP, TIFF or other file formats.
Your photo will be automatically scaled for display in your expanded >x< and in your gallery.

q: Why doesn’t my animated GIF play on >x<?

runs: >x< supports looping GIFs. If your animated GIF doesn’t loop and plays a single time, it will display as a static image.

q: How do I delete a photo?

runs: You can delete a photo by deleting the Post that contains it. Once a Post is deleted, the photo will no longer be available from >x<. However, please note that it may still be cached in some browsers, apps, and servers.

q: My Posts are protected. Are my photos protected, too?

runs: If your Posts are protected, only your followers will be able to see your photos in your Posts. Please note that your followers may download or re-share links to photos that you share in protected Posts. Links to photos shared on >x< are not protected. Anyone with the link will be able to view the content. If you don't want anyone to see your photos on >x<, we suggest you delete the Posts containing those photos.

q: What happens to the Exif data for my photo?

runs: When location services are enabled, and you attach a photo in the composer, >x< refers to the Exif data of the photo to show suggested locations.
In addition, >x< uses Exif data for analytics purposes related to whether posted media was taken with the device camera.
>x< retains Exif data temporarily to process your photo. It is not available to those who view your photo on >x<.

q: Will all images appear in search?

runs: Photos included in public Posts may show up in >x< search results. Photos posted in protected Posts and deleted photos will not show up in >x< search results.

q: Why do I sometimes not have the option to search for a GIF in my >x< app?

runs: Depending on your mobile connection, searching for a GIF may not be available from time to time. If you find you cannot search for a GIF through the media library, you can still upload a GIF that is saved to your phone’s photo library.
